notes: RE-CLASSIFICATION: county instrument, STATE legislative office. Same filer (Glacus Gregory Merrill) previously filed genuine County Council reports in 2014 — a filer's earlier county filing does NOT make a later state filing a county one, so this is decided from this page alone. Each filled figure carries a hand-drawn arrow across to the CUMULATIVE column and the annotations 'see attached sheet'; the THIS-REPORT and CUMULATIVE boxes themselves hold no digits and are recorded blank.
